integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Cinematic, Guochao mythological style, splash-ink landscape, vivid colors with ink texture, wide shot frames a massive waterfall cascading like a white silk ribbon, surrounded by colorful mist and rainbows. A group of monkeys (S3) with various fur colors stand at the base looking up. An elderly monkey (S1) with white fur and wrinkles points at the waterfall and speaks. The character (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 哪一个有本事的，钻进去寻个源头，不伤身体，我等即拜他为王！</d> The other monkeys (S3) look at each other with hesitation.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of a Stone Monkey (S2) with golden fur and a vigorous physique leaping forward from the crowd. The character (S2) shouts: <d>[Chinese] 我进去！我进去！</d> The camera performs a Tracking Shot with large amplitude at fast speed, following (S2) as he jumps towards the water curtain.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the camera follows (S2) through the water curtain, slowing down to show the impact of water droplets, and then cuts to a medium shot inside the cave. (S2) lands steadily on a stone bridge and turns around to wave. The camera performs a Static Shot to capture his excited expression.

overall_soundscape:
The deafening roar of a massive waterfall cascading down, accompanied by the turbulent sound of rushing water and splashing. The rustling of fur and the hushed whispers and gasps of the monkey group are heard, followed by a loud shout and the splash of a body entering water.
